card.name: The word for after a statement
card.fires_on: The word "for" (or similar purpose words like "provided" and "provide") that begins a phrase of purpose. It often opens a sentence in website notices such as "For more information" or "For permission".

modes.label: Sentence-opening For in site notices
modes.description: "For" starts a sentence pointing to more information or permissions at the end of a web page notice.
modes.example: <<For>> more information, please see CDC's Exit

modes.label: For in tables and formulas
modes.description: "for" follows a bracket or a statement and introduces a value or range being listed.

modes.label: Provided or provide for a purpose
modes.description: The word "provided" or "provide" is followed by a purpose phrase such as "for information only".
modes.example: Links to other sites are<< provided>> for information only

card.plain: It marks the word "for" and similar words that introduce a purpose or a pointer to more information, mostly in website notices.
